user.title: Set up FreeLLM Chat
user.description:
FreeLLM Chat uses the external [LLM7.io service]({website_url}). The API token is optional. Without a token, anonymous chat access is available with at least three models and, depending on the live catalog, possibly more. Create a [free API key]({api_key_url}) for higher published limits and read the [provider documentation]({docs_url}). The currently published reference values are 500,000 tokens per 24 hours and 60 requests per hour anonymously, or 1,000,000 tokens per 24 hours and 250 requests per hour with a free key. These values can change; check [service status]({status_url}).

**Important:** AI responses may be inaccurate. Do not rely on them for legal, medical, financial, emergency, or safety-critical decisions. LLM7.io can change models, features, prices, and limits without notice. The service and this integration are provided as is.

model.title: Choose the initial model
model.description: The loaded catalog currently contains **{free_model_count} models marked as usable without usage billing**. Access mode: **{access_mode}**. The live catalog is authoritative and may change. You can switch models later on the FreeLLM device. Device control uses function calling, which LLM7.io currently documents as a paid feature.

chat_settings.title: Chat, context, and output
chat_settings.description: Configure the model, response behavior, streaming, image input, and history.

data_description.temperature: Lower is more precise; higher is more creative.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum output tokens per model response.
data_description.history_limit: Limits old messages while retaining complete turns and the system prompt.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: Limits consecutive tool rounds. Duplicate and excessive device actions are also blocked automatically.
data_description.enable_streaming: Shows text while it is generated when the model supports streaming.
data_description.enable_vision: Allows JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images from the latest user message. A vision-capable fallback is selected when required.
data_description.retry_count: Only connection, rate-limit, and temporary server failures are retried.
data_description.prompt: May contain Home Assistant templates. Device actions are additionally validated by Home Assistant.

model_settings.title: Models and fallback
model_settings.description: Filter models, choose a preferred fallback, and control catalog updates.

data_description.only_free_models: Always applies when no API token is configured. With a token, it hides usage-based models.
data_description.fallback_model: Used when the active model disappears or lacks a required capability.
data_description.auto_update_models: Regularly reloads the catalog and automatically corrects invalid selections.

control_settings.title: Home Assistant control and device queries
control_settings.description: Home Assistant official LLM tools perform actions. Additional read-only FreeLLM tools improve queries for devices, rooms, floors, states, numeric values, and unavailable entities. Only entities exposed to Assist are included. LLM7.io may restrict function calling depending on access mode.

data_description.enable_device_control: Allows Home Assistant official actions, state queries, and follow-up actions. Only entities exposed to Assist are available.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Assist is normally the right choice. Without a valid API, device actions and extended queries are disabled.
data_description.enable_extended_device_queries: Adds accurate name search, area and floor summaries, and filters by domain, device class, state, availability, numeric value, and recent changes. These extra tools never change devices.
data_description.device_query_max_results: Limits the size of one query result. Smaller values save tokens; larger values help with large areas.

usage_settings.title: Usage and reference limits
usage_settings.description: Configure the local warning thresholds. Use 0 to automatically apply the access-mode reference values published on the LLM7.io main website. Provider pages can temporarily show different values, so these fields can be adjusted without a code update.

data_description.reference_token_limit_24h: 0 = automatic. Used only for the local estimate; it does not change the provider account.
data_description.reference_request_limit_hour: 0 = automatic. Locally observed completed API attempts are counted.
data_description.reference_request_limit_minute: 0 = automatic. Locally observed completed API attempts are counted.
data_description.reference_request_limit_second: 0 = automatic. Locally observed completed API attempts are counted.
